title: Home
heading: Hi, I'm Ginny!
subtitle: I'm a creative leader with 16+ years of experience across creative direction, UX/UI design, and team management.
heroBody: I have helped brands like Procter & Gamble, Diageo, Jollibee Foods Corporation, The Coffee Bean and Tea Leaf, and Jewelmer establish and grow their brand presence on TV and print, social, and digital media.
portraitAlt: Illustration of Ginny: a smiling woman with glasses and shoulder-length hair, in a striped top
companyIntro: Below is a snapshot of my career journey.

companyProjects.title: Led a 3D production team & drove 3D art direction
companyProjects.description: As Production Manager, I guided a team of as many as 33 artists delivering 3D assets for product listings across amazon.com, then shifted into an art director role for the Design Operations Team where I drove creative direction, crafting concepts for 3D product visualizations that would be used to drive as many as 100 purchases in a single day for Amazon's Echo Dot, Kindle, electronic accessories, and more.
